svg.title: Step 7: the verdict and the fix-it plan
svg.desc: Every case ends as complete (everything proven clean), incomplete (ghosts found) or not applicable (not a deletion request). An incomplete case gets an ordered plan. Find: a ghost in a backup and a sync still copying data, each with the file that proves it. Fix: stop the sync, block the restore, then delete the copy, so leaks stop before cleanup. Check: the sync is off, the restore is blocked, the copy is gone. On the 32 public sample cases every verdict was right and every step the agent wrote was correct.
svg.text: The verdict and the fix-it plan
Every case ends with one of three verdicts, and the steps come in a safe order.
stop the leaks first, then clean up
Tested on 32 sample cases: every verdict right, every step it wrote correct.
